entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lafayette Green Pool was an American tank-crew and tank-platoon commander in World War II and is widely recognized as the US tank ace of aces, credited with 12 confirmed tank kills and 258 total vehicle and self-propelled gun kills, over 1,000 German soldiers killed and 250 more taken as prisoners of war, accomplished in only 81 days of action from June 27 to September 19, 1944, using three different Shermans. He received many medals and decorations, including the Distinguished Service Cross, the Legion of Merit, the Silver Star, the Purple Heart, the Belgian fourragère, and the French Legion of Honour.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Lafayette G. Pool's actions during World War II resulted in over 1,000 German soldiers killed and 250 taken as prisoners of war, making him the US tank ace of aces. His achievements had significant regional impact on the outcome of the war.
